hero.title: Bolella Dintlha tsa Masipala
hero.subtitle: Ka potlako
hero.description: ServeSA e kopanya baahi le mmuso wa selehae ho bolella le ho latela dintlha tsa tshebeletso. Fumana ditlhahiso tsa nako e nepahetseng mabapi le ditlaleho tsa hao 'me u bone tshusumetso sechabeng sa hao.

features.title: Hore na ServeSA e Sebetsa Joang
features.subtitle: Mokgwa o bonolo, o potlakileng le o hlakileng wa ho bolella ditlaleho tsa tshebeletso ya masipala

step1.title: 1. Bolella Bothata
step1.description: Nka setshwantsho 'me u hlalose bothata. AI ya rona e thusa ho arola le ho bea maemo ditlalehong tsa hao.

step2.title: 2. Latela Tswelopele
step2.description: Fumana ditlhahiso tsa nako e nepahetseng boemong ba ketsahalo la hao, nako e akanyetsweng ya tharollo, le ditlhahiso tsa tswelopele.

step3.title: 3. Bothata bo Rarollotsoe
step3.description: Fumana netefatso ha bothata ba hao bo rarollotsoe 'me u bone tshusumetso sechabeng sa hao.

categories.title: Bolella Bothata Bofe kapa Bofe
categories.subtitle: Ho tloha ho ho tshoha ha metsi ho fihla ho ho senyeha ha tsela, re sebetsana le dinyehelo tsohle tsa tshebeletso ya masipala

cta.title: O Loketse ho Etsa Phapang?
